text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(Taiki...! I may not be able to match you 
in toughness, but still!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"If it's JUST about speed!! 
RAAAAAAAAGH!!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh...!? Grrrrrrrrrrgh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sprint-distance sharpness. Pouring 
everything into a single fleeting moment. 
That decision is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was the right choice. Seeking the 
Pearl achieved a magnificent victory over 
world champion Taiki Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! That's right, I can! As long as I 
believe in my potential, I can even 
surpass the mighty Taiki!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And it's not just me. ...We can! If you 
understand and hone your own potential, 
anyone can overcome the wall.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Peepole all over the world! Burn this into 
your memories. This victory—is proof of 
it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-san... was so fast... Just like a 
flash of light...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Seeking the Pearl! It's 
Seeking the Pearl!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle got caught off guard, 
perhaps? Under these conditions, letting 
one slip away might have been unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
These... conditions...? A missed 
opportunity...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl falls silent. Her joy 
quickly hid behind that deep 
thoughtfulness of hers.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Come to think of it, maybe 
it was in reverse... the other way around.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. It's the reverse of the Prix Jacques 
Le Marois."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You said it yourself, didn't you? "1600m," 
"European deep turf," "soft ground." None 
of them suit me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This time it's the exact opposite: 1200m, 
shallow Japanese turf, and a hard track 
surface...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everything was in my favor. I simply 
defeated Taiki under conditions that were 
supremely advantageous to me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A win is a win. Beating Taiki is 
wonderful. However...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Can I really say that I've surpassed Taiki 
as an Umamusume, that I've shown hope to 
the world with this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Now that I think about it, that was 
true. I recall the victory announcement...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Under these conditions, slipping up might 
have simply been unavoidable."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many people might not consider me superior 
to the world champion based on this single 
race alone.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's no point unless they see that I've 
surpassed it perfectly. What I'm seeking 
is, yes—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Believe. Having people believe in you. If 
they don't believe in the possibilities, 
no one will ever change their actions.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Then, the brilliance we sought was—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's still incomplete. Not failed, right, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. We've only won a single race on 
our home turf where the odds were in our 
favor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unless we win under even conditions, we 
cannot make a definitive impression.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I've overcome countless walls before. But 
the next one is in a league of its own. 
Finally...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Against Taiki, I must overcome the wall 
built up by illness and suffering. To 
prove my potential."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm going to take on Taiki in the 
Mile CS!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
To win at 1600m—Taiki's best distance, and 
right at the absolute edge of my limit.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"That is the 'absolute strongest' beyond 
mere top speed. The end of the rainbow 
known as the Possible."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A heavy, resolute decision. But if she 
could overcome the roaring and defeat 
Taiki Shuttle in a mile race...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That will serve as the greatest message. A 
powerful message proving that both fate 
and handicaps can be overcome.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm not foolish. I've always made sure to 
draw the line between courage and 
recklessness...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's why I skipped the Prix Jacques Le 
Marois. However—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Is this challenge reckless? A foolish 
endeavor that is utterly beyond my power 
to achieve?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Here is what I think... I can! What do you 
feel?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I already knew Seeking the Pearl's 
abilities inside and out. All that was 
left... was how to make the call.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What does Seeking the Pearl live for? 
Factoring that into the equation—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Again. One more time.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: One more time! Louder!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay! That's right, Trainer. Are you 
ready? Listen closely.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is a challenge against odds that are 
nearly zero. A fate that supposedly cannot 
be achieved. But...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If you believe, there are things you can 
achieve. That is the very meaning of our 
meeting.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Together, to the ends of the earth. You'll 
keep moving forward with me, won't you? In 
order to bring light—to the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I nod firmly. Our feelings are one and 
the same."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to believe in the potential of 
Umamusume, in the potential of people. To 
that end, let us set an eternal milestone 
at the 'Mile CS'.
